invoicing.module.name: Invoices and exports
invoicing.module.description: Raise numbered invoices and record what is paid against them, and export the ledger in the layout another set of books takes, such as a students' union's return. Bills and credit notes follow.
invoicing.settings.exports.default-profi: Export profile the Exports screen opens on
With none chosen, Exports opens on the first profile by name.
invoicing.settings.exports.starter.label: First export profile
invoicing.settings.exports.starter.help: The profile made when the module is first switched on. A students' society starts from its union's return.
invoicing.settings.exports.starter.optio: A journal for any accounting package
invoicing.abilities.export.take.label: Take exports of the ledger and see past exports
invoicing.abilities.export.manage.label: Make and change export profiles and their codes
invoicing.abilities.settings.manage.labe: Change the invoices and exports settings
invoicing.settings.terms.days.label: Days to pay
invoicing.settings.terms.days.help: How many days after an invoice's date it falls due, unless the customer has terms of their own.
Furthest back an invoice may be dated
How long before it is issued an invoice may be dated, such as for work done before it was written.
invoicing.settings.issue.second-person-o: An invoice for more than this is issued by someone other than whoever wrote it. Leave it empty for anyone to issue any invoice.
invoicing.settings.pay.bank-details.help: The account name, sort code and account number customers pay into. These are printed on every invoice, so they are not a secret.
invoicing.settings.records.keep-for.help: How long an issued invoice keeps its customer's details once the accounts it belongs to have closed. It cannot be shorter than the law allows.
invoicing.abilities.invoice.view.label: See invoices and what has been paid against them
invoicing.abilities.invoice.draft.label: Write and change draft invoices
invoicing.abilities.invoice.issue.label: Issue invoices, which numbers them and posts them to the ledger
invoicing.abilities.payment.record.label: Record bank transfers and cheques received against invoices
invoicing.settings.pay.link-valid-for.he: How long the link in an invoice's email and its reminders opens the invoice. Sending one after the link has lapsed makes a new link.
invoicing.settings.reminders.enabled.hel: Reminds customers by email before and after an invoice falls due. Off stops every scheduled reminder; one sent by hand still goes.
First reminder before it falls due
How long before the due date the first reminder goes. Nought sends none before it.
invoicing.settings.reminders.first-after: How long after the due date the first overdue reminder goes.
invoicing.settings.reminders.second-afte: How long after the due date the second and last automatic reminder goes.
invoicing.settings.reminders.send-at.hel: The time of day reminders are sent.
invoicing.settings.rules.second-after-fi: The second overdue reminder goes later than the first.
